title: Clicking a work order card replaces the list in place with that order's lines, with a back control
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. A work order exists with at least two approved lines.
3. You are on the Schedule page with the work order list visible.
steps: 1. Click that work order's card in the sidebar.
expected: 1. The card list is replaced, in the same place, by that work order's lines (no new page or popup).
2. A back control is shown to return to the card list.
3. Clicking back restores the work order card list.
